record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Develop a theory of infinite cellular resolutions for minimal free resolutions of monomial ideals over quotient rings R = S/I, especially when I is monomial or toric.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field, $S = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ a polynomial ring, and $I \subset S$ a monomial (or toric) ideal. Set $R = S/I$, and let $J \subset R$ be a monomial ideal in $R$. The minimal free resolution of $R/J$ over $R$ is in general infinite. 

Recall that a (finite) cellular resolution, in the sense of Bayer–Sturmfels, is a free resolution of a monomial quotient $S/J'$ over $S$ whose differentials are encoded by the cellular chain complex of a labeled CW-complex, with the resolution being supported on that complex.

Develop a theory of infinite cellular resolutions that supports minimal free resolutions of monomial ideals over quotient rings $R = S/I$, in particular:

(a) Define an appropriate notion of an (infinite) labeled CW-complex (or more general cell-like combinatorial object) whose associated chain complex, suitably homogenized over $R$, yields a free resolution of $R/J$ as an $R$-module.

(b) Show that, for every monomial ideal $J$ in such a quotient ring $R$ (with $I$ monomial, and separately with $I$ toric), the minimal free $R$-resolution of $R/J$ can be realized as such an infinite cellular resolution.

(c) Identify combinatorial/topological invariants of the supporting cell complex that compute the multigraded Betti numbers of $R/J$ over $R$.
artifact.status_search_result: This is an open-ended research program rather than a single conjecture. While there are recent advances on cellular structures for resolutions over polynomial rings (e.g., Clark–Mapes, and work showing minimal resolutions are supported on posets) and on infinite resolutions via Pommaret-like bases, no comprehensive theory of infinite cellular minimal resolutions over monomial or toric quotient rings appears in the literature; the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Minimal free resolutions of monomial ideals and of toric rings are supported on posets
status_evidence.snippet: For any monomial ideal there is a homology CW-poset supporting a minimal free resolution; some minimal resolutions are not cellular.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress toward cellular/poset support of minimal resolutions exists over polynomial rings, but not a full theory over quotient rings.

status_evidence.title: Infinite Graded Free Resolutions (McCullough–Peeva)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of infinite graded free resolutions over quotient rings, highlighting open problems including cellular structure.
status_evidence.claim: Infinite resolutions over quotient rings remain an active area with many open problems.

status_evidence.title: Computing finite and infinite free resolutions with Pommaret-like bases
status_evidence.snippet: Develops algorithms for infinite resolutions over quotient rings using Pommaret-like bases.
status_evidence.claim: Recent algorithmic work addresses infinite resolutions, but a cellular theory is not established.
